normalizedResult: Implement Universal Handoff Binding v1.0 as a GitHub-independent private encrypted handoff compiler, loader, retrieval surface, fresh-process acceptance gate, portable encrypted export, truthful Create Handoff flow, hosted OAuth/ACL/key boundary, and actual new-ChatGPT handoff verification.

requiredOutcomes.text: Create Handoff snapshots state, diff, exact active episode, pending candidates, tracker/journal references, and constitution/runtime/audit versions into a manifest-backed encrypted private artifact.
A new authorized process can recover the handoff using only handoff_id and no Session A memory.
Expose the required handoff, state diff, recent verbatim, pending candidate, older evidence, tracker, and journal retrieval operations.
Preserve therapeutic steering, contradictions, uncertainty, trajectory observability, settled answers, failed paths, consent/method state, and exact candidate text.
Pass the >100k-character, simulated-20k-read-limit, fresh-process decision-equivalence regression.
Expose Current Saved State, What Changed This Turn, Create Handoff, and Export Private Handoff without hidden reasoning or premature completion language.
Keep runtime continuity independent of GitHub and keep all real case payloads outside public Git.
Preserve the parent real-case evidence layers; do not claim external availability from repository or local-process evidence alone.
Connect the hosted private MCP to ChatGPT and require a brand-new conversation given only handoff_id to call load_handoff before FRESH_SESSION_GREEN.
